lines.text: Joab refuses to let Ahimaaz carry the news because the king's son is dead, and sends a Cushite instead.
Ahimaaz insists on running, Joab says to run, and he goes by way of the Jordan and outruns the Cushite.
David sits between the two gates, and a watchman on the gateway roof sees men running alone.
The Cushite tells David that Absalom is dead, and David goes up to the chamber over the gate and weeps.
Joab swears by the LORD that every man will leave David unless he goes out, so the king sits in the temple.
